verdict.rationale: Glama is a hosted SaaS platform (MCP hosting, gateway, chat), so data residency is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region or residency. 'Private by default' covers listing visibility, not data location, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
